title: Herbal Stew
description: A flavorful and comforting stew made with a variety of herbs and vegetables.

ingredients.name: French stew
ingredients.notes: any type of stew suitable for this recipe

ingredients.name: Herbal
ingredients.notes: dried or fresh herbs of your choice (e.g. thyme, rosemary, parsley)

ingredients.name: Jubilant
ingredients.notes: any type of spice or seasoning that adds a joyful flavor

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onion, carrot, and potato, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the herbal mixture, stew, jubilant, and vegetable broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
